Introduction, 
A disaster is something that does a lot of damage. Sometimes, disasters hurt living things and the place where they live. These disasters are called environmental disasters. Water pollution can be an environmental disaster. Water is polluted when people put things like rubbish into it. Air pollution can also be an environmental disaster. Air can be polluted by things like gas or smoke.

Oil Spills 
Sometimes oil is spilled into water. Most oil spills are accidents. The most common accidents are when an oil tanker hits another oil tanker, or when an oil tanker hits the rocks.

Oil spills can kill birds, animals and fish. Oil sticks to fur or feathers. This stops the animals from keeping warm. They can die from the cold. They can also die from poisoning because they lick the oil from their fur or feathers.

Oil spreads quickly when it is spilled on water. This is called an oil slick. Some special tools are needed to clean up an oil slick. Sometimes a skimmer is used. A skimmer is a boat that skims oil from the surface of the water. Long pipes are also needed to suck up oil from around the rocks.

On March 16th, 1978, the Amoco Cadiz hit rocks off the north coast of France. The weather was very bad and this may have caused the accident. Lots of oil spilled into the sea. The strong winds made the oil spread all along the coast of France.
Oil was washed up onto the shore, turning the white beaches black. Fish and other animals were washed ashore. Nearly 20,000 dead birds were found. This was one of the world's worst-ever oil spills

On March 24th, 1989, another oil tanker caused pollution. The Exxon Valdez hit a reef in Alaska. The reef ripped holes in the ship and oil spilled into the sea. This caused a lot of damage to the environment.

The Exxon Valdez oil spill happened in a part of Alaska that was famous for its beautiful coastline and its wildlife. Both the coastline and the wildlife were badly affected by the oil spill. Over 250,000 seabirds, 2800 sea otters and 300 seals were killed

The accident happened a long way away from where people lived. People could only get there by boat or helicopter. Over 10,000 workers and 1000 boats helped with the clean-up. The cost to clean up the oil was over billion pounds
On June 3rd, 1979, the oil well, Inox 1, blew up. This accident happened when an oil drill went into a tank full of oil. The oil spilled into the sea off the coast of Mexico.

On December 3rd, 1984, a big cloud of toxic gas spread over Bhopal in India. A gas tank had burst at a factory. The gas tank let clouds of choking toxic gases into the air.

The gas spread quickly and after two days the gas had killed a lot of people. The gas also made thousands of people very ill. The toxic gas was so strong it made the leaves of Bhopal's trees turn black.
People are still getting ill because of the toxic gas in 1984. Thousands of children born after the disaster have not grown properly. Bhopal's water supply is still polluted by the toxic gas.
